newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse edges up in subdued trading.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse edges up in subdued trading.

text.p: Marginal price rises in key shares across the board lifted the Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index up marginally on Thursday amid subdued trade, bourse officials said.
The index gained 10.47 points to close at 3449.62. Turnover was posted at 11.4 million shillings on 321,960 shares from 115.7 million shillings on 975,300 shares on Wednesday.
"Today's trading was very dull. Absolutely nothing spectacular," a bourse official said.
Brooke Bond eased by two shillings to 123 while Rea Vipingo Plantations traded at 9.05 from 8.80.
Standard Newspapers closed at 17.40 from 14.50 while Uchumi Supermarket was unchanged at 40.25.
Foreign investors bought Kenya Commercial Bank at between 98 and 98.50 from 98.50.
Kenya Power & Lighting traded at 158 from 155 while Unga Group inched up to close at 128 from 122.
